tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground. Every public page sits on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The one raised ground: panels, the letter's margin, disabled controls, code. Never a card on every item.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on a record row or a table row.

tokens.name: accent-wash
tokens.usage: A selected row or chosen filter. `ink` and `accent` both read on it.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Main text and the heavy section rule, on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-hover` and `accent-wash` (14:1 and up).

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, captions, hints, on `bg` and `surface` (6.2:1 and up).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline between records and rows. Decorative only: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Edges that carry meaning: inputs, checkboxes, the dashed drop zone (3:1 on `bg` and `surface`).

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: The 2px rule that opens a section, a record or the header. The system's signature line.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one accent: primary action, links, the current item, 'what changed'. Rare by rule. Text on `bg`, `surface`, `accent-wash` (6.6:1 and up).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `accent` fill (7.7:1 light, 9.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 3px offset, on every surface.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done, granted, sent. Always with a word and the check glyph: it shares lightness with `danger`.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Waiting on someone: in review, pending. With a word and the clock glyph.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, revoked, destructive actions. With a word and the cross glyph.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral news: new, in contact. With a word and the dot glyph.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind a dialog or the open mobile menu.

styles.name: ar-display
styles.sample: مجلسٌ هادئ مع رجلٍ رأى الكثير
styles.usage: One per page at most: the home statement or the letter's first line. 34px on phones (`ar-display-sm`).

styles.sample: مجلسٌ هادئ مع رجلٍ رأى الكثير

styles.name: ar-h1
styles.sample: أعمل مع المؤسسات حين يصعب القرار
styles.usage: Page titles and his sentence at the top of a page. 28px on phones.

styles.name: ar-h2
styles.usage: Section titles, project and article titles in lists.

styles.name: ar-body
styles.sample: أبدأ دائماً بالاستماع. قبل أي خطة، أجلس مع من سيعيشون نتائجها.
styles.usage: All running Arabic text. Keep lines near 34em.

styles.sample: Across the table from someone calm

styles.name: en-h1
styles.sample: I work with institutions when decisions are hard

styles.name: en-body

styles.usage: Running English text. Keep lines near 36em.

styles.name: en-small
styles.sample: A referral path run by residents.

styles.name: mono-meta
styles.usage: Latin dates, file types, sizes, codes, times. Never Arabic words: Plex Mono has no Arabic.

styles.name: mono-figure
styles.usage: Latin figures that line up: times, table numbers in English.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Label to field, tag padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding in dense tables, chip gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Record row padding, phone side gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gaps inside a record, between a label column and its value.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Grid gutter at 1280px and up.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page side margin at 1440px.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Between sections. 64px on phones.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Everything: buttons, fields, photos, dialogs. The record has square corners.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Only true circles: a radio button, a status dot, an initials avatar in the dashboard.

tokens.name: rule-hair
tokens.usage: Between rows and records, in `line`.

tokens.name: rule-heavy
tokens.usage: Opens a section, a record, the header, in `rule`. Also the field's bottom edge and the current-item underline.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Only things that float: dialogs, menus, the mobile menu. Nothing on the page itself casts a shadow.

tokens.name: measure-ar
tokens.usage: Max width of running Arabic text.

tokens.name: measure-en
tokens.usage: Max width of running English text.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Content width at 1440px (64px margins).

tokens.name: label-col
tokens.usage: The label column of a record row (الحال / ما فعلتُ / ما تغيّر). 88px on phones.
